The "Deduct: our share of equity in earnings from sale of unconsolidated JV properties", "Add: our share of loss on extinguishment...", and gain on insurance recovery lines are shown as "—" for the quarter and recorded as 0. Diluted shares printed as 18,699,000 on the per-share page, converted to thousands (18,699); check: 5,490/18,699 = $0.29 and 6,568/18,699 = $0.35. Company has no core FFO metric. Recurring capex of $961,000 BRT share (gross $1,108,000) is from the Capital Expenditures table for the quarter ended June 30, 2024; the table is printed in full dollars, converted to thousands. AFFO does not subtract recurring capex, so it is disclosed here separately.
